senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. המם)to be noisy, excited, with אחר to rush after, be greedy, envious &c.—
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:11">Cant. R. to VIII, 11</cite> <he>הָמוּ</he>, v. <cite ref="E00597"><he>הָמוֹן</he></cite> a. <cite ref="E00599"><he>הֲמוֹנוּת</he></cite>. Part. <he>הוֹמֶה</he>, v. infra; fem. <he>הוֹמִיָּה</he>. Y. M. Kat. III, beg. 81ᶜ (in a riddle) <he>ה׳ בירכתי ביתה</he> she (the soul?) is restless in the corners of her house.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 77:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVII</cite> <he>הוֹמִים</he> are in commotion.

Lev. R. s. 22 (ref. to אוהב בהמון, Koh. V, 9) כל מי שהומה ומְהַמֶּה אחר הממון whosoever is greedy and covetous for money; ib. הומה ומה׳ אחר תורה ambitious to accumulate learning; a. e.—Part. pass. f. מְהוּמָּת anxious.
